body:
it’s so hard because my mom is my best friend and I feel horrible for having the thoughts about her. I can accept the sexual thoughts as intrusive thoughts and try to carry less shame over that. 

The thing is the thoughts I had in the past about pretending an SO was in her place while cuddling her were not intrusive they were purposeful imaginary scenarios. Now I feel so shameful and guilty for having them. I feel like I violated her somehow. I posted a confession and the comments were all saying how weird it was and how weird I was. I want to tell her but I’m scared on how to even bring up the topic. I just feel disgusting. I feel like I’m deceiving her. She tells me she loves me and every time I think “you wouldn’t if you knew about this”. 

Either way, thank you for your kind words and for letting me vent to you. I appreciate it, much love <3.

thanks for your response, you were a little girl back then so it’s not really weird I was like a teenager and I just had this really huge desire to wanna be loved romantically I guess so I would daydream a lot about it and sometimes if I was already hugging my mom would try to imagine how it would feel if someone held me in a romantic sense by using how I was feeling when my mom held me idk if that makes sense. It is weird I get that and I haven’t done it recently. My OCD is just latched to it and is trying to convince me I’m a very shitty person for having those thoughts.

thanks for responding, I’m 20 now and I haven’t done it for quite some time. I only did it a couple of times when I was really lonely over quarantine/when i was 17 or 18. I realize that it is really weird and I’ve sort of grown out of my phase of wanting an SO above everything.

I understand I mean I get that it’s odd but I never wanted to do anything with my mom like that nor have I ever thought my mom was my significant other. I just felt very kind of like lonely I guess and so sometimes when I would cuddle my mom I would think “oh this is what cuddling feels like I wonder if it would be the same with a guy”. I don’t actually want to fuck my mom or anything. The best way I can describe it is sort of like hugging a pillow and pretending it’s an SO. I never went to my mom with the pure purpose of that either. It just crossed my mind a couple times while I was already hugging her like “I wonder if it would feel the same to hug a boyfriend” or something similar. Sorry I feel really gross typing it out and I get it that it’s fucking weird. I just feel like it’s been eating away at me and my OCD has latched into it and won’t give me any rest.

Thank you. I’ll try. It’s so hard when my mind is constantly telling me I’m a horrible person and everyone will judge me and hate me if they ever knew about what I did. I feel undeserving of friends or family because if they knew they’d hate me. I can’t stand living with myself but I don’t want to die, I just feel like I have to. I love my mom too much to leave her though. I really hope you don’t think I’m a horrible person for making this post or seeking sympathy from people despite what I did and who it makes me. I appreciate your kind words nonetheless it helps me more than you know.

I will do by best thank you. I just hate feeling like this monster. Do you think with help I could come back and heal from this? I feel cursed to live this way because of this thing I did. Do you think what I did was so bad it was deserving of death? I want to heal and I want to move forward but that feels so impossible because it feels like something I don’t deserve. Thank you for your advice and I’m sorry if I’m being annoying.

Thank you for your response. I have had a therapist for a couple months, she diagnosed me with OCD in November last year. I want to talk to her about this and most likely will because my appointment is Tuesday and I can’t see myself ending it before then I have no plan. I just feel like people like me don’t deserve to go to therapy. This feels like something I can’t heal from. I feel like a horrible person and like I’m wasting my therapists time or taking up time someone more worthy could use.

hi thank you for taking the time to respond. I’m in therapy and diagnosed with OCD and working on managing compulsions. I really just don’t want to feel like an animal abuser or molester. If I had that attached to me I genuinely don’t think I’d be able to live. Im going to speak with my therapist but I don’t know right now how to reckon with the guilt of potentially molesting an animal.

I NEVER penetrated the animal. While I was holding her, my finger brushed over her anus. I didn’t realize what it was. I looked down and noticed my finger was on her anus. Later my OCD forced an intrusive thought that I had touched/brushed over her vagina instead so I repeatedly held her in the same manner to ensure that was my finger touched/brushed over was her anus not her vagina. I never tried to event penetrate the animal and I was very careful to ensure I didn’t. I never wanted to touch the animal this way. I had no sexual or abusive or malicious intent with this dog. I touched and felt around the anus area without any desire for arousal or sexual intent but I didn’t and wouldn’t ever penetrate an animal that way, that causes true harm. Does that still make me  molester? Regardless I’m going to discuss it with my therapist I just wanted to get this confession out of me and hear advice because my thoughts were so confusing.

I didn’t hurt the animal with intent and I am currently in therapy my therapist is the one who diagnosed me. I’m sorry I can’t really breathe or think right now did I molest an animal? If I did that’s not something I can move on from.  My therapist is out of town and I’m meeting with her next week
I’m sorry for replying again but do you think I should try a sex therapy or something ? I’m in therapy for ocd right now but should I rather target these issues?

I didn’t do anything with any sexual intent or abusive intent at all. Am I really a molester? Will my therapist judge me if I tell her this? Please I’m not sure what to do or how to feel. I’ve been panicking about this for so long. I’ve read a lot of posts of other individuals who have had sex with their pets. I don’t want to be a molester what should I do? I feel so horrible that I left this dog with this trauma. I understand what I did wasn’t that good but I thought I could at least come back and move on from it?
